input.incident_description: A container exits immediately when its entrypoint script starts.
input.recent_changes: A new start.sh file was copied into the image.
input.expected_behavior: The application container should remain running.

probable_causes: The entrypoint script is not executable inside the image.

recommended_steps.purpose: Inspect the script permissions inside the built image.
Set the executable bit before rebuilding the image.

verification_steps: Confirm the container remains running and review its logs.

input.incident_description: The test job fails during collection on the hosted runner.
input.expected_behavior: Pytest should import the backend application.

probable_causes: The workflow runs pytest from a directory where the backend package is not on Python's import path.

recommended_steps.purpose: Confirm the runner working directory and backend location.
Run tests from the directory containing the app package.

verification_steps: Confirm test collection completes without the import error.
missing_information: The workflow YAML working-directory configuration was not provided.

input.incident_description: The public application returns 502 Bad Gateway.
input.logs: connect() failed (111: Connection refused) while connecting to upstream, upstream: http://127.0.0.1:8000/
input.expected_behavior: NGINX should proxy requests to the application.

probable_causes: The upstream application is not listening on 127.0.0.1:8000.
The NGINX upstream address no longer matches the application binding.
evidence: connect() failed (111: Connection refused) while connecting to upstream

recommended_steps.purpose: Check whether any process is listening on the configured upstream port.
Validate NGINX configuration syntax before any reload.

verification_steps: Start or correct the upstream service.
Request the upstream directly with curl.
Request the public endpoint and review the NGINX error log.
missing_information: The application service status was not provided.
